note: Village of Verdigre campground in the trees at the south end of Wildwood Acres Park, on the southeast edge of town; oak-shaded, with three primitive sites and two sleeping cabins besides the camper pads. Communal water spigots (no per-site water). Playground, swimming pool (closed for the 2026 season for repairs). Pads are small (a 4/2022 RV Life reviewer called most of them too small, with a handful of larger pads; 9/2017: 'Not for large rigs', 27-ft trailer) - pick a larger pad. Dump station uncertain. --Claude
summary: Village parks page (2026) read: 14 camper pads + 3 primitive + 2 cabins, showers, FCFS camping (cabins via clerk), $15 electric / $10 without / $35 cabin, $95 wk, $335 mo - written manual. Amperage not stated (stored 30 left derived). Stored website is a 404; use https://verdigre.org/parksrec/. Pin is ~375 m off at the highway junction. Small-pad caveat for the 23-ft rule.
